interpretation: Scope: two complete reused Stage 3.36 reports bound to the same historical archived execution (candidate proposal-build) were inspected in full, together with the shared synthesis and audit pages, the two material audits and the two originals they cite; a confirmatory read of the evaluation artifact behind the official reach record was refused as out of scope. Dispositions: one accept each, partial adoption only. Neither report is adopted unqualified: the audit of report A records formal validity but no warrant for unqualified adoption with the final principal disposition pending, and the audit of report B records material correctness as fail for unqualified entire-report adoption. Adopted claims are confined to narrow observations the archived fields support; the defect items named by both audits are excluded and left unassessed. Supported observations: (1) the historical official reach outcome is recorded as not accepted, with the criterion defined as complete sampled execution plus terminal distance only, and the source profile agrees through its not-accepted task flag and its finite terminal position offset, which is not a solver fault; (2) the recorded sampled holding criteria fail, the sampled position error exceeding its position threshold and the sampled tip speed exceeding its speed threshold, the profile-level sampled settling check being available but not passed and the holding-level recorded window result being false while the holding record is marked available; (3) archived independent recomputation for reach, holding position and holding speed is available with empty missing material yet reports false recomputed results, and the request-level archived recomputation presentation classifies those pointers as available with a failed assessment and a preserved official result and states that an available boolean false is a failed criterion rather than absence of recomputation; (4) the execution is recorded as valid and complete with zero solver errors and zero force-bound violations, so the non-acceptance is not a solver or force failure; (5) timing records show a small nominal control period, every recorded control update counted as a deadline miss, measured mean complete update and total computation times far above the nominal period, and no demonstrated real time, all as measured fields rather than capability guarantees; (6) the one-step prediction summary covers aligned world-frame first-step predictions with small mean and maximum tip differences and no missing entries, but its own scope limits it to accepted first-step predictions matched to the next execution timestamp with no future-plan replay comparison, and the recorded limitations state such agreement is neither reach nor holding acceptance; (7) the holding record rests on sampled evidence without a continuous-time guarantee, and unavailable recomputation does not erase a recorded official result. Excluded interpretations, per the two audits: the claim that recomputation was not performed because the recomputed boolean is false; extending availability and recomputed results to the official object, which carries only recorded result, source and definition; treating the meaning of an available recomputed false, or whether recomputation happened, as unresolved; and seeking separate recorded holding component booleans. Unknown causes: the physical cause of the reach and holding shortfall is not established; no explicit matching repeat or replication appears in the supplied scope; both holding component criteria lack a recorded component-level pass/fail value; no per-update timing series and no defined deadline criterion or budget appear, so the deadline shortfall cannot be quantified beyond the recorded miss count; no continuous-time guarantee is recorded; the referenced evaluation, detail, motion-source, configuration, simulation and prediction-evidence artifacts were not read here; and whether the same execution would pass under any other evaluator or criterion version is not determinable. No new science, delegation or computation was performed and the reused reports remain unmodified.
